text:
iris: spotting a small but persistent uptick in 504s from eu-west1 since 04:08 UTC. suspect the prefix-cache allocation change in v3.2.1. want to push a minimal revert: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-hotfix-revert. Requesting expedited canary + rollforward if green.
noah: paste the short log snippet + rollback plan. Propose canary plan (size/windows).
iris: logs:
```
2026-03-25T04:09:10Z inference-3 error: prefix_cache_alloc > cap -> reclaim -> timeout 504
2026-03-25T04:09:12Z inference-3 warn: upstream closed during stream
```
image: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-hotfix-revert
rollback: pin back to v3.2.0, cordon & drain new nodes, redeploy, runbook section "hotfix-rollback" (RB-401).
tammy: suggest tiny canary: 2 pods eu-west1, 12m watch, ramp 50% for 8m, then full if OK. disable autoscaler on canary and enforce previous mem limit 7Gi.
deploybot: Deploy requested by iris -> eu-west1 canary (2 pods) image registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-hotfix-revert. CI: unit+smoke passed. Approvals required to proceed.
noah: +1 SRE, I approve canary. will monitor p95/p99 and 5xx.
oncall-bot: @iris assigned oncall until 2026-03-25T08:00Z. Alerts: high-5xx-rate, p99-latency, node-memory.
deploybot: Canary started: 2/2 pods ready, healthchecks OK. Observing 12m.
(deploybot) 04:23 UTC: 12m complete, canary stable. 5xx trending down.
tammy: authorizing ramp to 50%.
deploybot: Ramping to 50% for 8m.
04:33 UTC - deploybot: 8m done. Metrics: 5xx down ~90% from peak, latency stable, no new OOM traces.
iris: proceeding to full rollout for eu-west1 with a 10m final watch. changelog snippet drafted.
releasebot: Reminder: add final entry to internal changelog and tag release notes channel.
deploybot: Full rollout complete. Image tag: registry.redwood/inference:v3.2.1-hotfix-revert. No alerts during watches.
iris: opening follow-up RB-401 to add integration tests for prefix-cache changes. Marking thread resolved when changelog is published.
tammy: changelog updated, marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
